name: Swashikshan (Indian Association of Homeschoolers)

curriculum.summary: Swashikshan is a non-profit network of homeschooling children, parents, guardians and friends in India, formally launched in July 2012. It aims to make sure homeschooled children are not discriminated against, and to share a pool of resources among like-minded families. It is a community association, not a government body; no formal government designation was found.

how_to_check: Check facebook.com/swashikshan or homeschoolers.in for current joining steps; the official site did not load in this check.
